description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Fizz''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target location while becoming [[File:Untargetable icon.png|20px|link=Untargetable|An icon representing the keyword Untargetable]] [[:Untargetable|untargetable]], balancing on his trident for 0.75 seconds, during which he can cast ''[[File:Fizz Trickster.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Trickster|An icon for Fizz's ability Trickster]] [[Fizz#Trickster|Trickster]]'' after 0.15 seconds into the duration.
description.text: Active: Fizz dashes to the target location while becoming untargetable, balancing on his trident for 0.75 seconds, during which he can cast Trickster after 0.15 seconds into the duration.

description2.raw: He then begins to hop off of his trident over 0.5 seconds, during which he gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] 50% '''bonus''' movement speed, and afterwards becoming targetable and landing to create a splash that deals magic damage to nearby enemies and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slows]] them for 2 seconds.
description2.text: He then begins to hop off of his trident over 0.5 seconds, during which he gains  50% bonus movement speed, and afterwards becoming targetable and landing to create a splash that deals magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them for 2 seconds.

description3.raw: ''While hopping off of the trident, '''Fizz''' may input movement commands to direct his landing.''
description3.text: While hopping off of the trident, Fizz may input movement commands to direct his landing.

notes.raw: * This ability always employs [[Quick cast]]. *''Playful'' counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as [[File:Sheen item.png|20px|link=Named item effect#Spellblade|An icon representing the keyword Spellblade]] [[:Named item effect#Spellblade|Spellblade]] and triggering [[File:Kassadin Force Pulse.png|20xpx|border|link=Kassadin#Force Pulse|An icon for Kassadin's ability Force Pulse]] [[Kassadin#Force Pulse|Force Pulse's]] passive. **Detonating the ability early for [[File:Fizz Trickster.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Trickster|An icon for Fizz's ability Trickster]] [[Fizz#Trickster|Trickster]] does not. * The distance covered during ''Playful's'' directed splash is equal to half of '''Fizz's''' movement speed. * ''Playful'' cannot be used for approximately 0.5 seconds after using [[File:Fizz Urchin Strike.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Urchin Strike|An icon for Fizz's ability Urchin Strike]] [[Fizz#Urchin Strike|Urchin Strike]]. * [[File:Flash.png|20xpx|border|link=Flash|An icon representing Flash]] [[Flash]] can be used while hopping off the trident, but not while balanced on it. * '''Fizz''' can receive aggro while hopping off the trident, but not while balanced on it * If the first dash is interrupted, '''Fizz''' initiates the hop immediately, and if the second one is, the splash will not occur. ** In either cases, '''Fizz''' loses the untargetability. [https://youtu.be/Zjtcee-OvUQ] (unexpected)[[Category:Unexpected behaviours]] * If ''Playful'' is cast while under the effect of a move block, '''Fizz''' will not become untargetable and will initiate the hop instantly.(bug) ** If [[File:Fizz Trickster.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Trickster|An icon for Fizz's ability Trickster]] [[Fizz#Trickster|Trickster]] is cast, the splash will not occur.(bug) * If '''Fizz''' casts ''Playful'' on top of himself after [[File:Flash.png|20px|link=Blink|An icon representing the keyword Blink]] [[:Blink|blinking]] and not moving from the blinked-to spot, the minimum dash distance of 25 units will not apply (casts at 0 range).(bug) * If '''Fizz''' enters [[File:Stasis icon.png|20px|link=Invulnerability#Stasis|An icon representing the keyword Stasis (buff)]] [[:Invulnerability#Stasis|stasis]] during either ''Playful'' or [[File:Fizz Trickster.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Trickster|An icon for Fizz's ability Trickster]] [[Fizz#Trickster|Trickster]], the splash occurs after the stasis ends.
notes.text:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
Playful counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse's passive.
*Detonating the ability early for Trickster does not.
The distance covered during Playful's directed splash is equal to half of Fizz's movement speed.
Playful cannot be used for approximately 0.5 seconds after using Urchin Strike.
Flash can be used while hopping off the trident, but not while balanced on it.
Fizz can receive aggro while hopping off the trident, but not while balanced on it
If the first dash is interrupted, Fizz initiates the hop immediately, and if the second one is, the splash will not occur.
* In either cases, Fizz loses the untargetability. [https://youtu.be/Zjtcee-OvUQ] (unexpected)Category:Unexpected behaviours
If Playful is cast while under the effect of a move block, Fizz will not become untargetable and will initiate the hop instantly.(bug)
* If Trickster is cast, the splash will not occur.(bug)
If Fizz casts Playful on top of himself after blinking and not moving from the blinked-to spot, the minimum dash distance of 25 units will not apply (casts at 0 range).(bug)
If Fizz enters stasis during either Playful or Trickster, the splash occurs after the stasis ends.

description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Fizz''' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] to the target location, hopping down and splashing onto the ground prematurely upon arrival to deal the same magic damage in a smaller radius but not applying the slow.
description.text: Active: Fizz dashes to the target location, hopping down and splashing onto the ground prematurely upon arrival to deal the same magic damage in a smaller radius but not applying the slow.

notes.raw: * This ability always employs [[Quick cast]]. * ''Trickster'' does not count as an ability activation. * Both [[File:Fizz Playful.png|20xpx|border|link=Fizz#Playful|An icon for Fizz's ability Playful]] [[Fizz#Playful|Playful's]] and ''Trickster's'' [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashes]] may be directed separately. * [[File:Flash.png|20xpx|border|link=Flash|An icon representing Flash]] [[Flash]] cannot be used during the dash. * The splash occurs immediately if '''Fizz''' encounters terrain that cannot be dashed through (he has to be particularly close to the wall).
notes.text:
This ability always employs Quick cast.
Trickster does not count as an ability activation.
Both Playful's and Trickster's dashes may be directed separately.
Flash cannot be used during the dash.
